description: What every headless adaptor understands, whichever CLI it drives: the executable to run, the directory to run it in, and where a run's state is kept. This is a partial and closes nothing: an adaptor's own lib/agents/<id>/options.schema.json names these three by $ref, adds what only its CLI takes, and refuses everything else.

command.description: The CLI executable, on the PATH or by path.

workspace.description: The directory the run works in; empty takes the options' repo when it is a directory, else the working directory.

state_dir.description: Where a run keeps its prompt, output, pid and exit code; empty is .ops/cache/agents/<adaptor id> under the project.
